messages:
Fix free shipping threshold: count quantities, include exactly 50.00 €

shippingFor summed unit prices without multiplying by quantity, so three
17.00 € bottles were charged shipping, and it used > rather than >= so an
order of exactly 50.00 € was charged too. Shipping is now decided on
unit price × quantity, free at 50.00 € or more.
